'''''Z-Tallon 3''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] that fought on the side of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|coup]] during the [[Second battle of Imperial Center]]<ref name="TIE fighter guide" /> in around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">Per ''[[TIE Fighter Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]'', the [[Second battle of Imperial Center]] takes place directly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which is dated to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. Therefore, the battle must have taken place around 4 ABY.</ref> During the battle, it was target by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series|TIE fighter]].<ref name="TIE fighter guide" />
